eat.tagline: One table, new faces, a great spot
eat.text: New in town, or your friends are always busy? Join a table of people who also want to meet someone new. We put the table together and book the restaurant: come alone or as two.

move.tagline: Get moving with people at your level
move.text: Fancy padel, yoga or a run, but nobody to come along? Join a small group that wants to do the same thing. The court or studio is booked: all you have to do is show up.

play.text: Escape game, quiz, paintball or board games: playing breaks the ice in minutes. We build balanced teams so everyone has a good time.

create.text: Pottery, Moroccan cooking, perfume, zellige painting: your hands are busy and the conversation flows on its own. You leave with what you made… and new contacts.

discover.tagline: Meet lots of people in one night
discover.text: A sunset rooftop, a Gnawa night, a street art walk: outings open to everyone, to see the city differently and cross paths with new faces.

meet.tagline: Meet-ups to talk and settle in
meet.text: Language exchanges, book clubs, newcomer get-togethers: formats built for conversation, perfect when you've just moved to Casablanca.

learn.text: An Art Deco tour, a specialty coffee class, a talk: you learn with a guide or an expert, and share the discovery with other curious people.

pages.howIntro: The Host Club organises experiences designed to meet new people, without you having to organise anything.
pages.safetyText: Public places and verified partners, community rules accepted by every member, only useful details (first name, profile photo, interests) shared with your group, and you can report any behaviour after each experience.
pages.aboutText: We believe people connect better around a table, a yoga mat or a puzzle than through a screen. The Host Club was born in Casablanca to help everyone widen their circle, discover their city and break their routine.
pages.contactText: A question, a partnership idea or a place you'd like us to discover? Write to us.
pages.contactDemo: The contact form is enabled on the live site. Meanwhile, write to us by email.
pages.legalDraft: Document being drafted with our legal advisers (Law 09-08 and CNDP requirements). It will be published before bookings open.

pages.faqMore: More answers in the help centre
pages.step1Text: Universe, neighbourhood, price, level: filter the catalogue. You can come on your own — that's the whole point.
pages.step2Text: Remaining spots are shown. Full? Join the waiting list: if a spot frees up, it's offered to you.
pages.step3Title: Help us put your group together
pages.step3Text: Your languages and interests (your profile) and, for some activities, a short questionnaire. Diet or allergies for a meal, if you wish.
pages.step4Text: Only on the website, with the payment method shown. On-request experience: you only pay once your request is accepted.
pages.step5Text: Ticket with a QR code, reminders the day before and 3 hours before, practical info, and the venue or your group revealed at the right time.

faq.a1: No. The Host Club brings people together around experiences to make new friends and widen their circle.
faq.q2: Can I come on my own?
faq.a2: Yes, that's the whole idea: our experiences are designed for people who come on their own. For dinners and group activities, we put the tables and teams together.
faq.a3: Based on the languages you speak, your interests, age ranges and the balance of the group, avoiding always seating the same people together. Our team approves every group.
faq.a4: Yes. Each experience shows its cancellation terms on its page before you book; the most common: free cancellation up to 48 hours before. The refund amount is always shown before you confirm. If we cancel, you get a full refund.
faq.q5: How old do I need to be?
faq.a5: The Host Club is for people aged 18 and over.
faq.a6: Your spot and all the organising: the venue, the group, the welcome. What is included on site (menu, drinks, equipment, class) is detailed on each experience page, under “Included”.
faq.a7: Each experience lists its languages (French, Darija, Arabic, English…). The languages in your profile help us put together groups where everyone can join the conversation.
faq.q8: I have a dietary requirement or an allergy: what should I do?
faq.a8: Tell us when you book, under “For your welcome”: diet, allergies and preferred languages. With your consent, we pass it on to the venue so it can prepare. You can change it from your booking until the experience starts.
faq.a9: You choose a length (1, 3, 6 or 12 months depending on the plans offered), paid once. During that time you get the member price on experiences (shown next to the public price) and, depending on the plan, no service fee, early access to new dates and members-only experiences. No automatic renewal.
faq.a10: You can leave at any time. Talk to the venue staff or our team, and report any inappropriate behaviour: we handle every report. All our experiences take place in public venues. See the Safety page.

aboutPage.founderP1: After ten years in France, Aya came back to Casablanca with a simple wish: to find her place at home again, among people who share her culture, her humour and her references.
aboutPage.founderP2: The city has no shortage of places to go — cafés, gyms, restaurants. What was missing was an easy way to actually meet someone. She started with small meetups; very quickly, requests outnumbered the seats available.
aboutPage.founderP3: While looking for her own place, she created one where everyone can find theirs. The Host Club carries that idea forward.
aboutPage.value1: A welcome by your first name, introductions: nobody is left on their own.
aboutPage.value2: Carefully curated groups that never get too big: the community grows naturally rather than just bigger.
aboutPage.value3: Dinner, brunch, workshop or simply conversation: each gathering starts from a venue or a shared interest.
aboutPage.value4: A good gathering is one where you leave with someone you'll want to see again, outside our events.
aboutPage.photoAlt: Portrait of Aya Snoussi smiling in a restaurant
aboutPage.heroEyebrow: Why we do what we do
aboutPage.heroPhotoAlt: Participants laughing together around a table
aboutPage.toolsTitle: Our tools for bringing people together
aboutPage.toolsText: Digital tools serving real-life encounters and friendships.
aboutPage.tool1: No profiles to scroll, no online chat to start. Our tool puts balanced groups together, whether it's a table or a team (languages, ages, interests); our team reviews them, and you meet in person.
aboutPage.tool3: For some formats, you send a request: the team puts the group together, and you only pay once your spot is accepted.
aboutPage.tool4: Full? Sign up: if a spot opens, you're told and can book it before anyone else.
aboutPage.tool5: Diet, allergies, preferred languages: add them when booking and we pass them on to the venue with your consent. When you arrive, check in in the app: your group appears so you can find each other.
aboutPage.tool6: The day before and 3 hours before, a reminder with the venue and time. If anything changes, you're told straight away.
aboutPage.tool7: Member prices on experiences and, depending on the plan, early access to new dates and members-only experiences.
aboutPage.tool8: After each experience, leave a review: your feedback helps us choose venues and put better groups together.
aboutPage.galleryText: Smiles, new encounters and real connections. These are the moments when strangers come together and share something real.
aboutPage.galleryAlt: A shared moment at a The Host Club experience ({n})
aboutPage.tool2_card: Choose a universe and a date, pay by card on a secure payment page and get your ticket as soon as it's confirmed.
aboutPage.tool2_bank_transfer: Choose a universe and a date, pay by bank transfer with your unique reference and get your ticket as soon as the payment arrives.
aboutPage.tool2_none: Choose a universe and a date, book your spot and get your ticket as soon as it's confirmed.

transfer.step1: Make the transfer from your bank (app, branch or counter).
transfer.step2: Write the reference {reference} in the description.
transfer.step3: As soon as it arrives (usually 1 to 2 business days), we confirm and email you your ticket and invoice.
transfer.receivedText: Thank you! Your payment is confirmed.
transfer.closedTitle: This transfer is no longer expected
transfer.closedText: The deadline has passed or the booking has changed. Already made the transfer? Write to us with proof: we'll give you a spot if one is left, otherwise we'll refund you.

questionnaire.title: Your questionnaire
questionnaire.intro: Two minutes to help us shape your group (level, preferences…). Your answers are only used to place you with the right people and are deleted 30 days after the experience.
questionnaire.introDone: Thank you, your answers are saved. You can change them until the experience starts.
questionnaire.closed: The experience has started: answers can no longer be changed.
questionnaire.errorGeneric: Couldn't send right now. Please try again in a moment.

propose.title: Propose an outing
propose.intro: Got an idea for an outing (padel, a hike, a workshop, a quiz…)? Propose it: the team reviews it, finds the venue and price, then publishes it. You're kept posted at each step.
propose.notTrusted: This page is for trusted members: regulars the team invites to organise their own outings. Have an idea meanwhile? Write to us.
propose.descriptionHint: How it goes, the vibe, who it's for (at least 30 characters).
propose.datesHint: E.g. “Saturday mornings in December” or “a Sunday afternoon”.
propose.priceHint: Optional: the team sets the final price.
propose.willHost: I will take part in the outing too.
propose.reviewNote: Nothing is published without the team: we check the venue, safety and price before creating the page.
propose.sentText: Thank you! The team will review it and reply in your notifications.
propose.sentDemo: Demo: nothing was sent. On the live site, the team receives your proposal.

errors.tooManyProposals: You've already sent 3 proposals today: try again tomorrow.
errors.notTrusted: Proposals are for trusted members only.

organizerPage.title: Become an organiser
organizerPage.intro: Do you run workshops, sports outings, tours or evenings? Publish your dates on The Host Club and sell your places online to people who come to discover and meet others.
organizerPage.why1: You create your listings and dates from the organiser space; the team reviews them before they go live.
organizerPage.why2: Online payment, reminders, cancellations and refunds are handled for you; you receive your sales by bank transfer, minus commission.
organizerPage.why3Title: People who come to meet others
organizerPage.why3: Curious members, often coming alone, who leave a review after each experience.
organizerPage.step1: Create your account and present your activity (supporting documents, insurance for physical activities).
organizerPage.step2: The team checks your application and opens your organiser space.
organizerPage.step3: Publish your activities and dates; each new listing is reviewed before going live.
organizerPage.step4: Participants book and pay online; you follow your sales and receive your payouts.
organizerPage.venueLink: Do you run a venue that wants to host our groups? Become a partner venue

organizerPage.roleOrganizer: Organiser: publishes and sells their own activities on the site.
organizerPage.roleTrusted: Trusted member: a regular invited by the team to propose outings, which we publish.

meeting.principle: How it works: you join people who don't know each other either. We put the groups together to make conversation easy, in a friendly, no-pressure setting.

reviewsPage.questionsTitle: What we ask after every experience
reviewsPage.questionsIntro: On top of the overall rating, everyone can rate the group, the organisation and the venue, and say whether they'd come again. Averages of every answer received.
reviewsPage.ctaText: Leave a review from your bookings: it helps other members and helps us put better groups together.

audiences.partnersText: On the dates you choose, we bring you a small group of people who don’	 know you yet. Everyone pays for their own order: you simply keep a table or a space free.
audiences.organizersText: Workshop, sports outing, tour, games night: publish your dates on The Host Club. Bookings, online payment and reminders are handled, so you can focus on the experience.
audiences.sectionText: Three ways to bring The Host Club to life: host our groups, publish your activities, or suggest outing ideas.
audiences.trustedText: You come often and have an idea for an outing? The team invites regular members to become trusted members: you propose an outing, we check it, then we publish it.

checkIn.early: On the day, from 30 minutes before the start, check in here: you will see your group to find them. There is no host: everyone finds each other through the app.
checkIn.groupHint: Find your group’s first names below and look for The Host Club sign on the table or at the meeting point.
checkIn.soloHint: Show your ticket at the venue’s front desk if needed. Enjoy!
checkIn.hostHint: A hostess welcomes you on site and introduces your group.
checkIn.error: We couldn’t save your arrival right now. Please try again in a moment.
